semiconductor_relevance: Medium — CeNSE contributes to the semiconductor value chain through its advanced research and development facilities and industry collaborations.
summary: The Centre for Nano Science and Engineering (CeNSE) at IISc is a research institution that supports the semiconductor industry through its state-of-the-art nanofabrication and clean room facilities. It focuses on interdisciplinary research in nanoelectronics, MEMS/NEMS, and other nanoscale systems, and fosters industry collaboration through its technology business incubator.
capabilities: Advanced nanofabrication and clean room facilities
Micro nano characterization for materials and devices
Systems and Packaging Facility for device packaging
Technology business incubator supporting semiconductor start-ups
